## Continuing with the plane crash example

```{r crashes}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# This should now print without the error
crash_page

crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()
crash_tables


# From cleaning perspective, we must:
# Translate this into a df
crash_df = crash_tables[[1]] # subsetting of a list

# Replace the current headrs wh row 1 and delete row 1
colnames(crash_df) = crash_df[1, ]
crash_df = crash_df[-1, ]
# Convert date into a date column instead of chr
crash_df = crash_df |> 
  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))

dplyr::glimpse(crash_df)
# More complex cleaning to split muktiple information within a cell into seperate columns
```

# Game

```{r Game}
## Question 1

page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes)

## Question 3

base <- "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"

starts <- seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages <- vector("list", length(starts))

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg <- rvest::read_html(
    paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i])
  )

  pages[[i]] <- data.frame(
    class = pg |>
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |>
      rvest::html_text2(),

    value = pg |>
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |>
      rvest::html_text2() |>
      readr::parse_number()
  )

  Sys.sleep(1)
}

registry <- dplyr::bind_rows(pages)

dreadnought_df = registry |> 
  dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought")

sum(dreadnought_df$value)
```
